overlayBuilder.families.samurai.name: Samurai
overlayBuilder.families.samurai.desc: Today's alerts in Ronin red: a blade cut, a torii gate, a tally board, a folding screen and war banners, with the omikuji for the giveaway.
overlayBuilder.families.racing.name: Racing
overlayBuilder.families.racing.desc: Night-race graphics: a headlight streak leaves a carbon panel, then a race number, nitro, a sponsor decal, headlights or a victory lap. Your card, accent and name colours, the name's font and the text stay yours.
overlayBuilder.families.grandprix.name: Grand Prix
overlayBuilder.families.grandprix.desc: TV broadcast graphics: start lights, the timing tower, sector colours, team radio, race control and the podium.
overlayBuilder.families.cockpit.name: Cockpit
overlayBuilder.families.cockpit.desc: The display on your wheel: shift lights, gear, delta, the rev counter, the pit stop and the spotter.
overlayBuilder.families.arcade.name: Arcade
overlayBuilder.families.arcade.desc: A 90s arcade racer: chrome letters, CHECKPOINT!, NEW RECORD!, coins and a sunset road.
overlayBuilder.families.quest.name: Quest
overlayBuilder.families.quest.desc: Fantasy RPG: a scroll for follows, LEVEL UP! for subs, a treasure chest for bits, a royal decree for donations, a shield wall for raids and legendary loot for giveaways.
overlayBuilder.families.comic.name: Comic
overlayBuilder.families.comic.desc: A pop-art comic book: panels that slam in, KAPOW! starbursts, speech bubbles, halftone dots and thick black ink.
overlayBuilder.families.cozy.name: Cozy
overlayBuilder.families.cozy.desc: Paper and stickers: a sticky note, a polaroid, a jar of stars, a love letter, paper boats and a gift box, all written by hand.
overlayBuilder.families.cosmos.name: Cosmos
overlayBuilder.families.cosmos.desc: Space: a countdown and liftoff, moons in orbit, a meteor shower, an incoming transmission, a fleet warping in and a supernova.
overlayBuilder.families.glass.name: Glass
overlayBuilder.families.glass.desc: Clean and quiet: frosted panels, one soft sheen and numbers that count up. For streamers who want alerts that stay out of the way.
overlayBuilder.families.spooky.name: Spooky
overlayBuilder.families.spooky.desc: Playful Halloween: a ghost pops up to say boo, a cauldron brews the months, a treat bucket fills with candy, a tombstone rises with the tip, bats swarm across the moon and a jack-o’-lantern pops its top for the winner.
overlayBuilder.families.cyber.name: Cyber
overlayBuilder.families.cyber.desc: Neon cyberpunk: access granted for a follow, a system upgrade for a sub, a data stream of credits for bits, a decrypted message for a donation, a system breach for a raid and a hologram for the giveaway winner.
overlayBuilder.families.western.name: Western
overlayBuilder.families.western.desc: The wild west: a wanted poster for follows, a sheriff’s badge for subs, a gold pan for bits, a telegram for donations, a posse riding in for raids and saloon doors bursting open for giveaways.
overlayBuilder.families.retro.name: Retro OS
overlayBuilder.families.retro.desc: A 90s desktop: a dialog that zooms open, an install wizard, a file copy, new mail, a cascade of error boxes and the card-game win screen.
overlayBuilder.families.graffiti.name: Graffiti
overlayBuilder.families.graffiti.desc: Street art on brick and concrete: a spray-can tag, a bubble-letter piece, paint splats under a sticker, a pasted-up poster, a crew of tags and a sprayed crown.
overlayBuilder.families.kawaii.name: Kawaii
overlayBuilder.families.kawaii.desc: Cute and pastel: a cat peeks up and waves, a bubble tea fills with pearls, mochi bounce, a bunny holds up a card, a parade of friends hops in and a gacha machine pops out the winner.
overlayBuilder.families.steampunk.name: Steampunk
overlayBuilder.families.steampunk.desc: Brass and gears: turning gears drive out a nameplate, a pressure gauge rises to the months, a coin press mints the bits, a pneumatic tube delivers the message, an airship fleet brings the raid and a clockwork box raises the winner’s name.
overlayBuilder.families.frost.name: Frost
overlayBuilder.families.frost.desc: Winter and festive: a snow globe shakes for follows, an ornament spins onto a pine branch for subs, presents stack up for bits, a mug of hot cocoa steams for donations, a reindeer sleigh crosses the moon for raids and the northern lights light up the giveaway winner.
overlayBuilder.families.neon.name: Neon Sign
overlayBuilder.families.neon.desc: Neon signs on a brick wall at night: an open sign flickers on for follows, a motel sign for subs, a diner counter for bits, a billboard for donations, a street of little signs for raids and a theatre marquee for the giveaway winner.
overlayBuilder.families.deepsea.name: Deep Sea
overlayBuilder.families.deepsea.desc: Under the sea: a bubble pops into the follower’s name, a clam opens on a glowing pearl, a school of fish swirls round the bits, a message in a bottle brings the donation, a pod of dolphins leaps in for raids and jellyfish light up the giveaway winner.
overlayBuilder.families.music.name: Music
overlayBuilder.families.music.desc: Stage and DJ booth: the needle drops on a spinning record for follows, an equalizer settles at the months for subs, speakers pump out a bass drop for bits, a cassette plays the request for donations, a crowd raises its hands for raids and a framed record is engraved with the winner.
overlayBuilder.families.stadium.name: Stadium
overlayBuilder.families.stadium.desc: Match night at the arena: the jumbotron welcomes a follower, a season ticket slides out of a turnstile for a sub, a ball flies into the net for bits, the LED sponsor board thanks a donor, the stands do a wave for a raid and a trophy rises under the floodlights for a giveaway.
overlayBuilder.families.fireworks.name: Fireworks
overlayBuilder.families.fireworks.desc: A night sky celebration: a sparkler writes the follower’s name in light, a countdown bursts into the months, a volley of rockets for bits, one big shell for a donation, a barrage of shells for a raid and a willow finale around the giveaway winner.
overlayBuilder.families.dino.name: Dino
overlayBuilder.families.dino.desc: A friendly prehistoric adventure: footprints stomp in and a dino holds up a sign for follows, an egg hatches for subs, a volcano erupts gems for bits, a brush uncovers a fossil for donations, a herd stampedes in for raids and a drop of amber sets around the giveaway winner.
overlayBuilder.families.ufo.name: UFO
overlayBuilder.families.ufo.desc: Playful aliens: a saucer beams down the follower’s name, a crop circle counts the months, cows float up into the beam for bits, the saucer’s screen decodes donations, a fleet lands for raids and the mothership spotlights the winner.
overlayBuilder.families.news.name: Breaking News
overlayBuilder.families.news.desc: TV news and the newspaper: a BREAKING NEWS bar for follows, an EXTRA! front page spinning in for subs, a market chart for bits, a live report for donations, a weather map for raids and the press printing the winner on the front page.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-samurai.desc: A blade crosses and the band appears along the cut. Short, because follows come often.
Pillars plant, both beams drop and the name plaque hangs from its cords.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-samurai.title: Tally board
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-samurai.desc: The blade crosses the board and flips each digit tile as it passes.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-samurai.de: Six panels unfold, the rails snap across and the amount is struck.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-samurai.title: Banner rank
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-samurai.desc: Five banners plant outside-in; the standard lands last, carrying the count.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-samurai.de: The fortune box is shaken twice, a stick strikes out and the slip unrolls with the winner, stamped “great blessing”.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-racing.title: Fly-by
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-racing.desc: A headlight streak flies past and leaves the panel behind it; the name lands with a speed smear and three chevrons light up.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-racing.d: A race-number roundel slaps onto the panel with the months as the number, then the name and the tier.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-racing.title: Nitro
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-racing.desc: The nitro gauge charges, further for more bits, then the flame fires and the amount rolls up.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-racing.des: The amount is slapped on like a sponsor's sticker and a gloss runs across it; the donor's name and message sit below.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-racing.title: Headlights
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-racing.desc: A formation of headlights switches on, one pair per raider up to twelve, while the count of drivers rolls up.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-racing.des: A light laps the panel's outline and leaves it lit, then the winner's name glows. The prize sits on a tag.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-c1.title: C1 billboard trailer
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-c1.desc: Your C1 tows a billboard onto the stream with the donation on it. Made for you.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-c1-channel: A C1 tows a billboard onto the stream with the donation on it, your channel’s name on its rear window.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-grandprix.de: Five red lights come on one by one and go out together, and the name launches off the line.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-grandpri: The subscriber overtakes all the way up the timing tower to P1. The tier is the tyre: soft, medium or hard.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-grandprix.desc: Three sectors light up as the amount counts up. The more bits, the more purple; 1,000 or more is a purple lap.
The radio waveform plays while the donor’s message is typed out, like a driver’s radio on the broadcast.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-grandprix.desc: Race control throws the red flag, and one car per raider fills the pit lane.
The podium rises step by step, the winner lands on P1, the trophy appears and champagne sprays from both sides.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-cockpit.desc: The shift lights build, flash blue, the gear changes from N to 1 and the name scans onto the display.
The delta swings from red to green and PERSONAL BEST flashes. The lap counter is the months; the engine map is the tier.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-cockpit.title: Redline
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-cockpit.desc: The rev needle sweeps as far as the bits take it. 1,000 or more hits the red line and bounces off the limiter.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-cockpit.de: The car stops in the box, four tyres change and the fuel fills with the amount. A bigger tip gets a faster stop. Then GO GO GO.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-cockpit.title: Spotter
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-cockpit.desc: The spotter calls cars left and right while the radar sweeps and fills with one blip per raider.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-cockpit.de: LAST LAP, then FINISH: P1 lights up in gold and a rainbow runs across the shift lights.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-arcade.title: Checkpoint!
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-arcade.desc: CHECKPOINT! zooms in over speed lines, and the name is typed in with a blinking cursor.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-arcade.d: A sunset road scene opens like an attract screen. The months are the stage number; the tier is the class.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-arcade.title: Bonus!
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-arcade.desc: The amount pops in chrome, the credits counter rolls up and coins burst out. 1,000 or more says HIGH SCORE!
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-arcade.des: The donor slides onto the high-score table in 1st place, NEW RECORD! zooms in and the message is typed like name entry.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-arcade.title: Warning!
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-arcade.desc: The screen shakes, hazard stripes roll, WARNING! flashes and the rival convoy drives in: one car per raider, up to ten.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-arcade.des: Chrome WINNER! over a spinning starburst, the name typed as player 1, and pixel confetti.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-quest.title: Quest accepted
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-quest.desc: A parchment scroll drops in and opens between its two wooden rods, showing the follower’s name written on it, then a glint of gold runs across. It rolls back up to leave.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-quest.de: The XP bar fills and flashes, then the level-up: a crest stamps on with the months as the level, rays burst behind it and LEVEL UP! rises. The name follows, with the tier as stars.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-quest.title: Treasure chest
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-quest.desc: The chest lands with a thud, its lid swings open, gold light pours out and coins spill around it, more for more bits. The amount unfurls on a ribbon.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-quest.desc: A decree unrolls downwards from its rod and shows, line by line, the amount in gold, the donor’s name and the message. A red wax seal stamps on last.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-quest.title: The horde approaches
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-quest.desc: The board appears, war banners rise from behind it, and a wall of shields slams in, one per raider up to nine, while the count of warriors rolls up.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-quest.desc: An item card lands face down, then turns over to its glowing legendary front while rays fan out behind it: the winner is the item, the prize its description.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-comic.title: New hero
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-comic.desc: A comic panel slams in, a yellow caption box drops onto its corner, a hero badge pops and a speech bubble says the new follower joined.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-comic.de: A jagged starburst explodes, KAPOW! slams onto it and a caption box rises with the subscriber’s name, tier and months.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-comic.title: BAM!
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-comic.desc: BAM! bursts, coins fly out of it (more coins for more bits) and a jagged sign slams in with the amount counting up. 1,000 or more adds KA-CHING!
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-comic.desc: A panel slams in, CHA-CHING! pops on its corner, a caption says who donated how much and the message appears in a speech bubble.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-comic.title: Incoming!
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-comic.desc: A three-panel strip slams in panel by panel: INCOMING!, the raider’s name with speed lines, then the head count with a row of little heroes.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-comic.desc: A splash page: halftone rays spin in, WINNER! slams down in giant extruded letters, the winner’s name unfurls on a ribbon and the prize lands in a caption.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-cozy.title: Sticky note
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-cozy.desc: A sticky note drops in and settles, washi tape slaps on, “hi” is written in by hand and a heart doodles itself.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-cozy.des: A polaroid slides in and develops: a doodled plant grows one leaf per month, up to twelve, and flowers after a year.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-cozy.title: Jar of stars
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-cozy.desc: The jar’s lid lifts and paper stars drop in and settle, more stars for more bits; a tag swings in with the amount and a handwritten thank-you.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-cozy.title: Love letter
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-cozy.desc: An envelope slides in and its flap opens; a letter rises with the message in handwriting, the amount on a postage stamp, signed by the donor.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-cozy.title: Paper boats
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-cozy.desc: Paper boats sail in on paper waves and bob, one per raider up to eight; the count is circled in doodle and the raider’s name is written in.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-cozy.title: Gift box
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-cozy.desc: A wrapped box drops in and wiggles, the lid pops off with paper confetti and a gift tag rises out with the winner’s name and the prize.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-cosmos.title: Liftoff
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-cosmos.desc: A countdown flashes 3, 2, 1 and a small rocket launches up the side of the mission panel, leaving a trail; then the new crew member’s name appears.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-cosmos.d: A ringed planet appears and its moons swing into orbit, one per tier, while the months count up as the orbit number.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-cosmos.title: Meteor shower
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-cosmos.desc: Meteors streak across the panel and light up where they land, more of them for more bits, while the amount counts up as stardust.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-cosmos.des: A radar dish pings, a signal waveform draws itself and the donor’s message is typed out like a decoded transmission, with the amount on a credits tag.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-cosmos.title: Fleet arrival
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-cosmos.desc: Ships warp in from the left as streaks and snap into formation, one per raider up to ten, while the fleet size counts up.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-cosmos.des: A star swells and collapses, then explodes in a flash and a shockwave; the winner’s name glows in the light and the prize appears below.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-glass.title: Pill
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-glass.desc: A small frosted pill rises with one soft sheen: the follower’s initial in a circle that pings once, and their name.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-glass.de: A glass card with a ring that fills towards a year of months, the months counting up in its centre, the name and the tier.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-glass.title: Counter
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-glass.desc: A large number counts up with a soft glow above “from <name>”, and a hairline bar grows with the amount.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-glass.desc: An elegant card: a check mark draws itself, then the amount, the donor and the message as a quote, one line after another.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-glass.title: Wave
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-glass.desc: Ripples spread from a small icon while the raider’s name appears, and a row of avatars fades in, one per viewer up to twelve.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-glass.desc: A soft spotlight fades up over a glass card; “Winner” in small capitals, a light sweeps across the name, the prize below, a few tiny sparkles.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-spooky.title: Ghost hello
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-spooky.desc: A little ghost rises from behind a tombstone and two bats flutter off. It says “boo!” in a wisp with the follower’s name, then waves.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-spooky.d: A cauldron lands and its brew glows while the months count up on its side. Two bubbles float up and pop to reveal the label and the name, then the tier lines up as one to three potion bottles.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-spooky.title: Treat bucket
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-spooky.desc: A jack-o’-lantern bucket lands and wrapped candies drop in, more for more bits, while “+500 treats” counts up. Then its carved face lights up.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-spooky.des: A tombstone rises out of the ground and “Here lies €25.00 from <name>” is carved into it line by line, with the message carved below. A little ghost peeks over the top.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-spooky.title: Bat swarm
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-spooky.desc: A big moon rises, the raider’s name and “brings 42 ghouls” appear, and a swarm of bats flaps out from behind the card across the moon, one per raider up to twelve.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-spooky.des: A jack-o’-lantern lands and its carved face lights up. Its top pops off and sparkles fly out, the winner’s name glows in, and the prize swings in on a tag.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-cyber.title: Access granted
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-cyber.desc: A hologram panel boots from a line of light and tears in glitch slices; a scan opens the lock, ACCESS GRANTED glitches in and the name types out, connected.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-cyber.de: A segmented bar installs to 100%, then UPGRADE v4.0 glitches in with the months as the version number, the name scans in and the tier lights up as the clearance level.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-cyber.title: Data stream
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-cyber.desc: Columns of neon digits rain down and lock one by one into the amount, with more rain for more bits; then +500 CREDITS and the name scan in.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-cyber.desc: The amount flickers on in a neon tag and the sender scans in; an encrypted block scrambles, then the message decrypts character by character.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-cyber.title: Breach
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-cyber.desc: Red alert bars slam in with SYSTEM BREACH; a grid of nodes lights up one per raider, up to sixteen, and the raider scans in with the count of runners.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-cyber.desc: A projector lights up and a wireframe cube spins up in its beam, then folds flat into a line of light that opens into a glowing name plate: WINNER, the name and the prize.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-western.desc: A WANTED poster slaps onto a wooden wall in a puff of dust; one nail goes in, the poster swings, and a second nail pins it still.
A sheriff’s star spins in and pins onto a leather patch with a puff of dust. The months are on the badge; the tier sets its shine: trusty, polished or gleaming.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-western.title: Gold pan
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-western.desc: Gold nuggets tumble into a mining pan, more for more bits, with a big one on top from 1,000. The pan shakes, the gold glints and the amount rolls up.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-western.de: A telegram slip feeds out of the telegraph while its key taps; the message is typed with a STOP after every sentence, then PAID is stamped on with the amount.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-western.title: Posse
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-western.desc: Riders gallop in at sunset and pull up in a cloud of dust, one per raider up to eight; a bigger raid also has riders watching from the mesas. The count rolls up on a wooden sign.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-western.de: The saloon doors rattle, burst open and swing; behind them the winner is on a REWARD poster, and the prize is stamped on as the bounty.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-retro.title: New window
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-retro.desc: A dialog zooms open from its outline and says the new follower has joined; then the mouse glides over and clicks OK.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-retro.de: An install wizard opens: the hourglass turns while the bar fills block by block and the month counts up, then Finish lights up. The tier is the setup type: Typical, Custom or Complete.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-retro.title: File copy
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-retro.desc: A copy dialog opens and pages fly from one folder to the other, more pages for more bits, while the count rolls up and the bar fills to 100%.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-retro.desc: A mail window opens and its envelope bounces in; the donor fills the From line, the amount is the subject and the message is typed into the body.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-retro.title: Error cascade
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-retro.desc: Error boxes pop up in a diagonal cascade, one per raider up to ten; the last one counts the viewers and names the raider.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-retro.desc: The old card game’s win screen: three kings bounce across the felt and leave trails, then a dialog pops up with You win!, the winner’s name and the prize.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-graffiti.des: A spray can sweeps across a brick wall and tags the follower’s name, with mist at the nozzle and two drips running down after it; then “new follower” is sprayed through a stencil.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-graffiti: A bubble-letter SUB piece is painted in layers: the fill, the black outline, then a blue 3D shadow and a shine. The months roll up in stencil, the tier is a row of stars and the name is tagged underneath.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-graffiti.title: Paint splat
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-graffiti.desc: Paint splats burst onto a concrete wall, more and bigger ones for more bits, and a sticker slaps on with the amount counting up and the name written in marker.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-graffiti.d: A paste brush sweeps down the wall and smooths a torn poster on; the amount rolls up on it, the message is printed below and the donor signs it in marker.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-graffiti.title: Crew
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-graffiti.desc: The raider’s name is sprayed on a concrete wall, then small crew tags pop up around it one by one, one per raider up to nine, with “crew · 42 deep” in stencil.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-graffiti.d: A spray can paints a crown on the wall and paint drips from it; the winner’s name is tagged underneath, sparkles flash and the prize is slapped on as a sticker.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-kawaii.title: Paw wave
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-kawaii.desc: A round cat peeks up from the bottom of a pastel bubble and waves its paw, little hearts float up, and the bubble says the name followed.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-kawaii.d: A bubble tea bounces in and fills up, one pearl drops in for every month (up to twelve), the straw pops in and the tier lands as a sticker next to the name and the months.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-kawaii.title: Mochi
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-kawaii.desc: Mochi pop up and bounce, more of them for more bits, each with its own little face; a speech bubble above them counts up the amount.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-kawaii.des: A bunny hops in behind a card and holds it up by the edge; the message is written on the card, the amount sits on a big heart and the bunny says thank you.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-kawaii.title: Friend parade
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-kawaii.desc: A parade of little chibi friends hops in from the left, one per raider up to twelve, under the raider’s name and the head count.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-kawaii.des: The gacha machine’s handle turns and the capsules rattle, a capsule rolls out and pops open, and the winner’s name springs out with sparkles; the prize hangs below on a tag.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-steampunk.de: Three gears spin up in mesh and drive a brass nameplate out of its slot; it locks with a puff of steam and “joined the guild” is typed under the name.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-steampun: A brass pressure gauge bolts on and its needle rises to the months; at the top the valve whistles a puff of steam and the tier lights one, two or three rivet lamps.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-steampunk.desc: A steam press stamps one coin per stroke, more coins for more bits; each coin hops onto the stacks beside it while the counter rolls to the amount.
A brass capsule shoots up a glass tube and pops open; a paper scroll signed by the donor unrolls, the message is typed onto it and the amount swings in on a brass tag.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-steampunk.desc: A brass porthole’s shutters open on a sunset sky and small airships sail in, one per raider up to six, with a far-off fleet behind them for bigger raids.
A clockwork box lands and its gears and balance wheel tick; the lid swings open and a glowing brass nameplate rises out with the winner’s name, the prize engraved on the box below.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-frost.title: Snow globe
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-frost.desc: A snow globe lands with a soft bounce and gives a little shake; the snow swirls up and settles, and the name appears inside the glass. “New follower” sits on the brass plate of its wooden base.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-frost.de: An ornament drops onto a snowy pine branch, catches with a little bounce and spins to a stop with the months engraved on it. The tier sets its colour: berry red, frost blue or gold.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-frost.title: Gift stack
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-frost.desc: Wrapped presents drop onto a snowdrift and stack up with a soft bounce, more presents for more bits, and a bow lands on top while the amount counts up.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-frost.desc: A glass mug fills with hot cocoa and marshmallows drop in, more for a bigger tip; the steam curls up into the amount, and the message and the name sit on a frosted card beside it.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-frost.title: Sleigh parade
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-frost.desc: A sleigh pulled by a line of reindeer, one per raider up to eight, glides across the moon and leaves a trail of sparkles; then the raider’s name and the number of elves.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-frost.desc: The northern lights ripple across a starry sky over a pine ridge, the winner’s name appears in their light while a few snowflakes drift down, and the prize lands on a frosted panel.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-neon.title: Open sign
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-neon.desc: A neon sign on a brick wall flickers on in two parts: NEW FOLLOWER in block tubes, then the name in cursive tube lettering, and a little arrow sign blinks once.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-neon.des: A tall motel sign lights up: its bulb border chases round once, MONTH flickers on while the months roll up, the name lights in cursive tube and the tier lights as one to three stars on top.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-neon.title: Diner counter
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-neon.desc: A diner counter sign lights up: the amount rolls up in neon digits while the bulb border lights further round for more bits, all the way round from 10,000; then the name lights.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-neon.title: Billboard
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-neon.desc: A billboard’s neon frame lights section by section and the amount flickers on in big neon digits; the donor signs it in cursive tube, and the message lights up on a light box below.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-neon.title: Street of signs
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-neon.desc: A row of little neon signs flickers on one by one down the street, one per raider up to ten and each a different shape, above the raider’s crew and the head count.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-neon.title: Marquee
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-neon.desc: A theatre marquee lights up: WINNER flickers on in tubes, the bulbs chase once round the frame and the winner’s name goes up on the letter board one letter at a time; the prize lights up on a light box below.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-deepsea.desc: A bubble rises from the deep and grows, then pops into a glowing plate with the name. Two little fish dart in and stop to look.
A clam on the sea floor opens on a glowing pearl engraved with the months. Starfish light up in the sand for the tier: one, two or three.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-deepsea.title: School of fish
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-deepsea.desc: A school of glowing fish swirls in from the open water, more fish for more bits, and settles in a ring round the amount as it counts up.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-deepsea.de: A bottle drifts down and settles on the sand. The cork pops in a burst of bubbles and the scroll inside unrolls with the amount, the message and the donor’s name.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-deepsea.title: Pod
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-deepsea.desc: Dolphins leap out of the water one after another, one per raider up to eight, splash back in and swim on together as a pod.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-deepsea.de: Three jellyfish rise from the deep and pulse once together. The winner’s name glows in their light and the prize sits on a shell tag.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-music.title: Needle drop
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-music.desc: The record spins up on the turntable, the tonearm swings over and the needle drops; the light ring around the platter comes on and the name lands under NOW PLAYING.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-music.de: A rack equalizer drops in and its bars jump up, fall back and settle at a level for the months, with the months on its display; the name lands below and the tier lights one to three stars.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-music.title: Bass drop
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-music.desc: Two speakers drop in and the bass hits on the downbeat: the cones pump and rings of light ripple out, more and wider for more bits, while the amount rolls up and the level meter fills.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-music.desc: A cassette slides into the tape deck with a clunk, ON AIR lights up and the reels turn; the amount is on the label and the message is written in as the track title, signed by the donor.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-music.title: Crowd
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-music.desc: The stage lights come on and sweep over a concert crowd that fills in from the back, and one hand goes up for every raider, up to fourteen; the plate says who brings how many to the show.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-music.desc: A record in your colour spins into the frame and lands under a spotlight; the plaque beside it is engraved with the winner’s name, then the prize.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-stadium.desc: The jumbotron swings into place and flickers on, a camera flash pops, WELCOME lights up column by column in the home colour and the name flips onto the screen.
A turnstile lands, its reader lights up and the arms click round, then a season ticket in the home colour slides out of the slot. The months are the season; the tier is the ticket class: General, Premium or VIP.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-stadium.title: Goal!
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-stadium.desc: A ball flies from the camera into the top corner and the net bulges; a burst in the home colour (bigger for more bits) and camera flashes go off in the crowd, GOAL! slams onto the scoreboard and the amount rolls up.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-stadium.de: The LED boards round the pitch light up: the donor’s name and the amount scroll in on the board in the home colour, then the message scrolls in on the board below.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-stadium.title: Crowd wave
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-stadium.desc: The floodlights come on and the stands do a wave from left to right; one section per raider, up to twelve, raises cards in the home colour, and the board counts the fans in.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-stadium.de: The floodlights clunk on and cross their beams over a plinth, a trophy in the home colour rises out of it, the winner’s name is engraved on the plate and ticker tape falls; the prize sits below.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-fireworks.de: A sparkler lights up and writes the new follower’s name in light, sparks flying off its tip, then glows on at the end of the name.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-firework: The sky counts down 3, 2, 1, a rocket climbs and the shell bursts around the months. The tier is the number of bursts: one, two or three.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-fireworks.desc: A volley of rockets climbs and bursts from the middle outwards, more rockets and bigger shells for more bits; then the amount glows in the smoke.
One big shell climbs, a beat of silence, and it bursts into the amount: the bigger the tip, the bigger the shell. The message appears on a plate below, signed by the donor.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-fireworks.desc: A line of shells launches from left to right, one per raider up to twelve, and bursts across the sky; the raider’s name and the head count sit on the plate below.
A rocket climbs to the top of the sky and breaks into a willow: its streams fall away on both sides and frame the winner’s name, and the prize lands on a plaque below.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-dino.title: Footprints
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-dino.desc: Four big footprints stomp across the sand, each with a little shake, then a friendly dino pops up from behind it holding a stone sign with the name.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-dino.des: An egg drops into its nest, rocks while a crack runs across it, and a baby dino pops out holding the months on a little stone, wearing the top of the shell as a hat. The tier is the number of spots on the shell.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-dino.title: Volcano
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-dino.desc: A volcano rumbles and puffs smoke, then erupts glowing gems that arc out and land around it, more of them for more bits. Lava runs down its sides and the amount counts up on a stone.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-dino.title: Fossil dig
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-dino.desc: A sandy slab thuds down; a brush sweeps the sand away in two strokes, uncovering a fossil, the amount carved in a coloured cartouche, the donor’s message and their signature.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-dino.title: Stampede
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-dino.desc: A herd stampedes in through the dust and pulls up in a row, one dino per raider up to eight (a bigger raid also has a herd on the horizon), while the ground rumbles.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-dino.title: Amber
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-dino.desc: A stone tablet thuds down; a drop of amber swells on a branch, falls and spreads around the winner’s name, glows, then sets with a shine. The prize is carved on the tablet.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-ufo.title: Beam up
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-ufo.desc: A saucer swoops in and wobbles to a hover while its lights run round the rim; its tractor beam slides down and lowers a plate with the name: followed (resistance was futile).
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-ufo.desc: Seen from above, a saucer spins over a night field and a crop circle draws itself around it, one ring per tier. The saucer zips off and the months roll up in the middle of the circle.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-ufo.title: Cow lift
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-ufo.desc: A saucer swoops in and its beam slides down to the grass; cows float up into it one by one, more of them for more bits, while the amount rolls up beside it.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-ufo.title: Transmission
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-ufo.desc: The saucer projects its screen: the amount rolls up on a display, the message arrives in alien glyphs and a scan line decodes it into English, signed by the donor.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-ufo.title: Invasion
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-ufo.desc: A fleet of saucers descends over the hills in formation, one per raider up to ten, with lights far off for a bigger raid; the leader lands last and switches on its beam.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-ufo.title: Mothership
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-ufo.desc: A giant mothership lowers into view, its lights chase round the rim and the crew peek out of the windows; the hatch opens and a spotlight reveals the winner, with the prize on a hologram tag.
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-news.title: Breaking
overlayBuilder.looks.follow-news.desc: A BREAKING NEWS bar wipes in, the lower third names the new follower, and the ticker below runs once and stops.
overlayBuilder.looks.subscriber-news.des: A newspaper spins in and lands still, EXTRA! EXTRA! is stamped above the headline and the months roll up in it; the tier is in the subhead.
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-news.title: Market ticker
overlayBuilder.looks.bits-news.desc: A market chart draws itself and the line climbs, higher for more bits, to the amount; the ticker underneath carries the name.
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-news.title: Live report
overlayBuilder.looks.donation-news.desc: A LIVE bug and a lower third wipe in with the amount and the donor, then the donor’s message opens below as a quote card.
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-news.title: Weather map
overlayBuilder.looks.raid-news.desc: A storm front sweeps across the weather map and leaves one cloud per raider, up to twelve; then the strap: raid front moving in, with the name and the count.
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-news.title: Front page
overlayBuilder.looks.giveaway-news.desc: A blank sheet lands and the press roller passes over it, printing a front page with the winner’s name as the headline and the prize as the subhead.

tutorial.step1.title: Log in with Discord
tutorial.step1.p1: Click {{b}}"Login with Discord"{{bEnd}} on the home page. This creates your account using your Discord identity.
tutorial.step1.p2: You'll be redirected to Discord to authorize. The bot only reads your username and avatar.
tutorial.step1.tip1: Click {{b}}"Authorize"{{bEnd}} to continue. No special permissions are needed — the bot only reads your public profile.
tutorial.step1.alt1: Atleta home page with Get Started with Discord button
tutorial.step2.title: Link Your Twitch Account (Optional)
tutorial.step2.p1: From the dashboard, click {{b}}"Link Twitch Account"{{bEnd}} if you want to enable subscriber role sync for your own channel. This step is optional — you can watch any Twitch channel without linking.
tutorial.step3.title: Add the Bot to Your Discord Server
tutorial.step3.p1: Click {{b}}"+ Add Bot to Server"{{bEnd}} from the dashboard. This opens Discord's authorization page in a new tab.
tutorial.step3.p2: Select which server you want to add the bot to and click {{b}}"Continue"{{bEnd}}.
tutorial.step3.li1: You need {{b}}Manage Server{{bEnd}} permission in the Discord server
tutorial.step3.li2: The bot will request permissions to send messages, embed links, and manage roles
tutorial.step3.li3: After authorizing, go back to the dashboard
tutorial.step3.alt1: Dashboard with Add Bot to Server button
tutorial.step3.alt2: Discord — Select a server to add the bot
tutorial.step4.title: Claim Your Server
tutorial.step4.p1: After adding the bot, your server will appear under {{b}}"Available Servers"{{bEnd}} on the dashboard. Click {{b}}"Claim"{{bEnd}} to link it to your account.
tutorial.step4.p2: Once claimed, you'll see the server settings page where you can configure welcome messages, subscriber role sync, and more.
tutorial.step4.tip1: Each server can only be claimed by one user. If someone else has already set up the bot on that server, you won't see it in the list.
tutorial.step4.alt1: Dashboard showing Available Servers with Claim button
tutorial.step4.alt2: Server settings page with Twitch Channels and YouTube Channels buttons
tutorial.step4.alt2NoYoutube: Server settings page with the Twitch Channels button
tutorial.step5.title: Add Twitch Channels to Watch
tutorial.step5.p1: Click the {{b}}"Twitch Channels"{{bEnd}} button on your server to manage which Twitch streamers you want notifications for.
tutorial.step5.p2: You'll see the Twitch Channels page. Enter any Twitch username and choose which Discord channels should receive live and clip notifications.
tutorial.step5.p3: Fill in a Twitch username and select the notification channels. You can set different Discord channels for live alerts and clips, or leave one disabled.
tutorial.step5.p4: Click {{b}}"Add Channel"{{bEnd}} and you're done! The channel will appear in your watched list and notifications will start within a minute.
tutorial.step5.alt1: Server settings showing Twitch Channels and YouTube Channels buttons
tutorial.step5.alt1NoYoutube: Server settings showing the Twitch Channels button
tutorial.step5.alt2: Twitch Channels page — empty state with add form
tutorial.step5.alt3: Filling in a Twitch username with notification channels selected
tutorial.step5.alt4: Channel added successfully with watched channels list showing
tutorial.step6.title: Add YouTube Channels (Optional)
tutorial.step6.p1: Click the {{b}}"YouTube"{{bEnd}} tab on your server settings to add YouTube channels. You can enter a {{b}}@username{{bEnd}} or {{b}}Channel ID{{bEnd}} (starts with {{c}}UC{{cEnd}}).
tutorial.step6.p2: Choose which Discord channels should receive {{b}}video/shorts notifications{{bEnd}} and {{b}}live notifications{{bEnd}}, then click {{b}}"Add Channel"{{bEnd}}.
tutorial.step6.tip1: Video/shorts notifications use the free YouTube RSS feed and don't need an API key. Live detection requires a YouTube Data API key.
tutorial.step6.alt1: YouTube tab — Add a YouTube channel form
tutorial.step6.alt2: YouTube channel added to watched list

tutorial.step7.p1: In your server {{b}}"Settings"{{bEnd}} page, enable the welcome message feature:
tutorial.step7.li2: Select which channel to send welcome messages to
tutorial.step7.li3: Optionally write a custom welcome message
tutorial.step7.alt1: Server Settings showing Welcome Message configuration
tutorial.step8.title: Enable Subscriber Role Sync (Optional)
tutorial.step8.p1: This feature automatically gives a Discord role to your Twitch subscribers:
tutorial.step8.p2: {{b}}1.{{bEnd}} First, link your Twitch account and click {{b}}"Enable Sub Sync"{{bEnd}} from the dashboard — this authorizes the bot to read your subscriber list.
tutorial.step8.p3: {{b}}2.{{bEnd}} In your Discord server, go to {{b}}Server Settings → Roles → Atleta{{bEnd}} and make sure the {{b}}Administrator{{bEnd}} permission is enabled.
tutorial.step8.p4: {{b}}3.{{bEnd}} Make sure the {{b}}Atleta role is above{{bEnd}} the subscriber role in the roles list. If it's not, drag it above — the bot can only assign roles lower than its own.
tutorial.step8.p5: {{b}}4.{{bEnd}} In the Atleta dashboard, go to your server {{b}}Settings{{bEnd}}, toggle on {{b}}Subscriber Role Sync{{bEnd}} and select the role. Your community members type {{c}}/link{{cEnd}} in Discord to connect their Twitch account.
tutorial.step8.tip1: The bot checks every 10 minutes and assigns or removes the role automatically. Subscribers need to use {{c}}/link{{cEnd}} once to connect their Twitch and Discord accounts.
